Served from here, not a CDN: the site's CSP allows scripts from 'self' only.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pptxgen.bundle.js` | PptxGenJS (with JSZip bundled) | 3.12.0 | MIT (`LICENSE-pptxgenjs`) |
